start.speaker: Elder Mwaringa of Bungale
start.text: Mekatilili! Wanje! The colonial recruiters came to Bungale demanding two sacks of grain from every granary and three young men from every shamba.

choices.text: Hide your harvest in the hill granaries. Do not give a single grain or youth to Champion.
Tell them the land gave this food to your children, not to British officers.

node_pledge.speaker: Elder Mwaringa of Bungale
node_pledge.text: You speak the truth of our ancestors! Bungale stands with you! Not one youth from our ridge will board the colonial labor wagons. Community Support is rising!

events.value: The farming settlement of Bungale has united with Mekatilili, refusing food seizures and forced recruitment.
